events.title: 👑 Court Decree Bar: Visual Update!
events.summary: Hey everyone!I've been working on improving the Court Decree Bar to make it feel much smoother and easier to use!The old version worked, but it wasn't always clear what was happening when moving things around. So I've made a few visual improvements!Here's what's changed:✨ Smoother visuals when selecting and moving decrees.👀 Clearer previews showing how far a decree would reach before you move it.🔄 Better highlights and indicators when swapping positions.🎨 Improved overall readability to make eve

events.title: ⚔️ The For Our King Demo is Out!
events.summary: Hey everyone!The demo for For Our King is now available on Steam! 🎉You can defend your Keep against waves of enemies, try out different units, and mess around with Royal Decrees to see what kind of crazy combinations you can come up with.I'm really curious to see what builds people manage to put together, especially with all the different modifiers and upgrades.If you run into any bugs, find something confusing, or just want to share your thoughts and suggestions, feel free to join the Discord!

events.title: Demo Coming Soon!
events.summary: Hello everyone,The demo build is done and in testing. I am running it through a final pass now and it goes up on the store page shortly.
